component.name: Odysseus
component.summary: File manager in the style of GNOME Files, with built-in tools
Gestionnaire de fichiers dans le style de Fichiers de GNOME, outils intégrés
Dateiverwaltung im Stil von GNOME Dateien, mit eingebauten Werkzeugen

description.p: Odysseus looks and behaves like GNOME Files (Nautilus) and follows the desktop theme. It integrates the features of popular Nautilus extensions, each of which can be switched off without restarting.
Odysseus ressemble à Fichiers de GNOME (Nautilus), se comporte comme lui et suit le thème du bureau. Il intègre les fonctionnalités d'extensions Nautilus, chacune désactivable sans redémarrer.

Odysseus sieht aus wie GNOME Dateien (Nautilus), verhält sich wie dieses und folgt dem Thema der Arbeitsumgebung. Es enthält die Funktionen von Nautilus-Erweiterungen, die sich jeweils ohne Neustart abschalten lassen.

ul.li: Dual panel, column view, preview panel and tabs
Archives with the 7-Zip engine: browse, extract, compress, split
PDF tools: compress, merge, watermark, pages
Video to audio, image annotation, checksums, search in file contents
Safe file operations: originals are removed only once copies are on disk
Double panneau, vue en colonnes, panneau d'aperçu et onglets
Archives avec le moteur de 7-Zip : parcourir, extraire, compresser, découper
Outils PDF : compresser, fusionner, filigrane, pages
Vidéo vers audio, annotation d'images, sommes de contrôle, recherche dans le contenu
Opérations sûres : un original n'est supprimé qu'une fois sa copie sur le disque
Zwei Fenster, Spaltenansicht, Vorschaubereich und Reiter
Archive mit der 7-Zip-Engine: durchsuchen, entpacken, erstellen, aufteilen
PDF-Werkzeuge: komprimieren, zusammenführen, Wasserzeichen, Seiten
Video zu Audio, Bild bearbeiten, Prüfsummen, Suche in Dateiinhalten
Sichere Dateivorgänge: Originale werden erst gelöscht, wenn die Kopien auf dem Datenträger sind
Archive window like the Archive Browser extension: archive tree on the left, a folder on the right
Extract everything or the selection into the folder shown on the right
Double-clicking an archive opens it in its own window: drag anything out of it to any folder
Dragging out of an archive is instant: the selection is extracted in the background
About window: special thanks to Ponce De Leon, Forpli and the Zorin forum users
Each folder keeps its own sort order, shared with Nautilus
Sort submenu in the background context menu
Default sort order in Preferences
Properties window sized to its content, no scrolling needed
Quick preview: the arrow keys now switch files in GNOME Sushi
.deb installer: no more alarming debconf messages, cleaner output
Quick preview: the preview follows the selection with the arrow keys, even when the keyboard stays in the file list
Properties laid out as in GNOME Files: size under the name, permissions on their own page, "Change Permissions for Enclosed Files…"
Custom folder icon from the Properties window, as in GNOME Files
Right-clicking in an empty folder opens the context menu (Paste, New Folder…)
Quick preview with the space bar, as in GNOME Files (GNOME Sushi); the arrow keys move to the next file
Batch rename: found text highlighted in orange as in GNOME Files, aligned preview columns
Image tools: resize, rotate and convert images (JPEG, PNG, WebP, TIFF; HEIC and AVIF read), several at once and in one pass, never overwriting

Batch rename, as in GNOME Files: rename using a template (original name, automatic numbers, photo, music and video metadata) or find and replace text, with a live preview and conflict checks; undone in one step
Type to find a file also works when the keyboard focus was lost after opening a folder from Other Locations
A folder opened from Other Locations or This PC gets the keyboard focus: typing to find a file, then Enter, opens it
Grid view: same cells and spacing as GNOME Files 46, emblems beside the icon
In search, the Down and Up arrow keys move from the search field into the results
Clicking an empty area clears the selection, as in GNOME Files
The file operations button shows a check mark once everything is done

description.p: New option: type the start of a name to go to the file without filtering the list, as in Nemo or Thunar.
Typing a path in the location bar suggests matching folders, as in GNOME Files.

ul.li: Search selects the best match as you type, and Enter opens it, as in GNOME Files
Opening a folder from the search results ends the search and shows its whole content
Long choices in drop-down lists are no longer cut off
Grid view: long names stay inside the selection
Bookmarks duplicating your personal folders (often added by Thunar) are hidden, as in GNOME Files

description.p: Holding dragged files over a folder opens it after half a second, as in GNOME Files.
